//: Package project: `src/` + `tests/` + the vitest config (so typescript-eslint's projectService can type-check it too). This is the *browser* side of the workspace: DOM lib, the Vite client types (CSS modules) and the React JSX transform. NOTE: because this project carries the vitest config, `vitest/config` re-exports jsdom's types and their `reference lib=dom` directive pulls the DOM lib in — irrelevant here (DOM is the point), but it also means the node-only half of the package needs its own probe: `tsconfig.node-probe.json` (`src/protocol`, `src/testing`; no DOM) while `tsconfig.dom.json` is the *no-node* gate (bare `process` is a compile error there).
